# <NNNN>. <Title in one line>

## Context

What forced a decision. The constraints that were real at the time — including
the ones that may not be real later.

## Options

| Option | For | Against |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A | | |
| B | | |

An option with no "against" was not seriously considered; either find it or drop
the row.

## Decision

What was chosen, and the reason that actually decided it — not the full list of
reasons it is defensible.

## Consequences

What this makes easy. What it makes hard. What it forecloses.

## Revisit when

The observation that should reopen this. Without one, this record can only be
overturned by argument.
